data.name: Catskill Mine: 10,000ft Below
data.detailed_description:
Catskill Mine is single-player horror game set in a decrepit roadside mine attraction. Descend to uncover the mine's dark history, and find a way to escape from the lurking horrors within.

Key Features

  • Ride an unstable elevator deeper underground while the shaft, hazards, and strange encounters change around you.

  • Your light and safety are tied to limited battery power. Push your luck, buy upgrades, or risk being stranded in the dark.

  • A stalking creature hunts through the mine, reacting to your progress and mistakes. Listen, watch, and use your tools before it reaches you.

  • Shop system to buy items to aid your descent.

  • Each descent is compact and replayable, with achievements/trophies rewarding speed, restraint, greed, and completion.

  • Radio calls, elevator noise, sonar, darkness, and sudden silence all matter. The mine is as much heard as seen.

Health Notice: Catskill Mine features flashing lights and visual sequences. If you are sensitive to strobe effects or prone to photosensitive seizures, please play with caution.

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 290
  • DirectX: Version 11

  • Sound Card: Windows compatible audio device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
